opportunities.name: Kayak hotel search with date, guest and price-sort setup
opportunities.description: Search hotels on Kayak Stays for a chosen destination, check-in/check-out dates and room/guest mix, then re-sort results by price (low to high) and optionally narrow by star class or review score.
steps: Click 'Stays' in the Kayak left sidebar.
Click the 'Enter a city, hotel, airport or landmark' field and type the destination; choose the matching suggestion.
Open the check-in date picker and click the start date, then click the check-out date (use the month arrows if needed).
Open the 'rooms, guests' control and set Rooms, Adults and Children with the +/- buttons; for each child, pick the age; click Done or Update.
On the results page, open 'Sorted by' and choose 'Price (low to high)'.
Optionally tick hotel class stars, review score (e.g. 8+) or amenity filters in the left panel.
parameters: number of children and their ages
sort order (usually Price low to high)
optional star class / review score / amenities

instances.values: Destination Le Marais, Paris; Mar 27 to Apr 2; 2 adults, 1 room (later 3 guests); sorted by price low to high (t=98.4).
Destination Santa Fe, New Mexico; date picker for Jun 5 to Jun 12 (first Santa Fe occurrence, interleaved with Qatar Stays work).
Destination Santa Fe, New Mexico; Fri Jun 16 to Sun Jun 18; rooms/guests changed from 1 room 2 guests to 2 rooms 3 guests.
Destination Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi; dates Apr 20-21 then Jun 6-10; guests changed to 3 adults, 1 child (age 7), 2 rooms; then star/review filters and sort by price low to high (t=1881.0).
Destination Los Angeles, California; dates May 21-30 range; guests and child age set.

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways one-way flight search with passenger and cabin changes
opportunities.description: Search Qatar Airways (Book > Flights / Qatar Stopover) for a one-way flight between two airports on a given date with a chosen passenger mix and cabin class, then pick a fare from the results.
steps: Open the Qatar Airways Book page and select the Flights or Qatar Stopover tab.
Click the 'From' field, type the origin city or airport code, and choose the matching airport.
Click the 'To' field, type the destination, and choose the airport.
Open the 'Depart' date picker, navigate to the month, click the date and press Continue.
Open 'Passengers / Class', set Adults, Child and Infant counts with +/- and pick Economy or Premium; click Confirm.
On results, click the fare column (e.g. Economy or Business) for the chosen flight, then 'Select fare' for the fare family.

instances.values: From Colombo CMB to To New York JFK; depart 28 May 23 then changed to 24 Jun 23; 3 passengers Economy.
From Colombo CMB to New York JFK, depart 24 Jun 23; passengers changed to 2 adults + 1 child, Premium cabin; Show flights, then Colombo to Doha results and Business Comfort 'Select fare' (t=1812.8).
From Doha DOH (replacing New York JFK) to Durban DUR; depart 28 May 23; passengers 3 (2 adults + 1 infant) Economy; selected Economy Classic fare at QAR 4,980.

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways Stays hotel search by destination and dates
opportunities.description: Search the Qatar Airways 'Save 15% on stays' hotel finder for a destination and date range with a guest/room count, then sort results by price.
opportunities.site: qatarairways.com (Stays hotel search, partner results page)
steps: On the Stays hero page, click 'Where are you going?' and type the destination; choose the matching suggestion.
Open the Check-in / Check-out date picker and click the start date, then the end date.
Open the adults/children/rooms control and set counts; click outside to close.
On the results page, open 'Sort by' and choose 'Price (lowest first)'.

instances.values: Destination Las Vegas, Nevada; date picker around April 2023 (dates in progress).
Destination Las Vegas, Nevada; Apr 10 to Apr 16 2023; 2 adults, 1 room; results sorted by Price (lowest first).
